title.en: Time series: meaning, components and models
title.kn: ಕಾಲ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ: ಅರ್ಥ, ಘಟಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾದರಿಗಳು

hook.en: Look at the monthly electricity bill of a home: higher every summer, slowly rising over the years, with an odd spike when guests stayed. That is a time series with all its parts.
hook.kn: ಮನೆಯ ತಿಂಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಬಿಲ್ ನೋಡಿ: ಪ್ರತಿ ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಏರಿಕೆ, ಅತಿಥಿಗಳು ಬಂದಾಗ ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಏರಿಕೆ. ಇದೇ ಎಲ್ಲ ಘಟಕಗಳಿರುವ ಕಾಲ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ.

objectives.en: Define a time series and state its uses
Identify the four components of a time series
Write the additive and multiplicative models

narration.en: Look at the monthly electricity bill of a home: higher every summer, slowly rising over the years, with an odd spike when guests stayed. That is a time series with all its parts.
narration.kn: ಮನೆಯ ತಿಂಗಳ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಬಿಲ್ ನೋಡಿ: ಪ್ರತಿ ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಏರಿಕೆ, ಅತಿಥಿಗಳು ಬಂದಾಗ ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಏರಿಕೆ. ಇದೇ ಎಲ್ಲ ಘಟಕಗಳಿರುವ ಕಾಲ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ.

body.en: A time series is a set of observations on a variable arranged in chronological order. Its four components: secular trend (T), the long-term smooth tendency to rise, fall or stay constant; seasonal variation (S), regular fluctuations within a year due to seasons, festivals and customs; cyclical variation (C), oscillations with a period of more than a year, such as business cycles; irregular variation (I), unpredictable effects of floods, strikes, wars.

points.en: Seasonal: period less than a year
Cyclical: period more than a year

narration.en: A time series has four components: the long-term trend, seasonal variations within a year, cyclical variations over several years, and irregular variations.
narration.kn: ಕಾಲ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಗೆ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಘಟಕಗಳಿವೆ: ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲೀನ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ, ವರ್ಷದೊಳಗಿನ ಋತುಮಾನ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ, ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಚಕ್ರೀಯ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಅನಿಯಮಿತ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ.

narration.en: The board draws a trend, adds a seasonal wave, names the four components and writes the two models.

say.en: First the trend: a steady rise over the years.
Add a seasonal wave that repeats every year.
Business cycles add a slower wave of several years; random shocks are the irregular part.
Two ways to put them together: add them, or multiply them.

body.en: Additive model: $Y = T + S + C + I$, used when the components are independent. Multiplicative model: $Y = T \times S \times C \times I$, used when the components depend on each other (for example, seasonal swings that grow with the trend). Uses of time series analysis: understanding past behaviour, forecasting, comparing series, and planning production, stocks and policy.

points.en: Additive: Y = T + S + C + I
Multiplicative: Y = T × S × C × I

narration.en: In the additive model the components add; in the multiplicative model they multiply. Time series analysis helps us understand the past and forecast the future.
narration.kn: ಸಂಕಲನ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಘಟಕಗಳು ಕೂಡುತ್ತವೆ; ಗುಣಾಕಾರ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಣಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಕಾಲ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ಭೂತಕಾಲ ಅರಿಯಲು ಮತ್ತು ಭವಿಷ್ಯ ಮುನ್ಸೂಚಿಸಲು ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

blocks.formula: Y = T + S + C + I \quad \text{or} \quad Y = T \times S \times C \times I

caption.en: Build a time series from its parts. Change the trend slope, the seasonal swing and the cyclical swing (a 4-year cycle).

tryThis.en: Set both amplitudes to 0. What is left?
Make the trend slope 0 and the seasonal amplitude 0. Can you see the business cycle?
Which component would a 3-year moving average remove?

narration.en: Every time series is a mixture of trend, seasonal, cyclical and irregular parts. Mix your own.

problem.en: Classify each movement: (a) rise in the population of India over 50 years; (b) increase in sales of sweets during Deepavali; (c) fall in production due to a strike; (d) boom and slump in business every 7–8 years.

steps.en: (b) Repeats every year at the festival: seasonal variation.
(d) Period of several years: cyclical variation.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Classify each movement: (a) rise in the population of India over 50 years; (b) increase in sales of sweets during Deepavali; (c) fall in production due to a strike; (d) boom and slump in business every 7–8 years.
Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ; ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now some questions in the pattern of the II PUC annual examination. Try them before we discuss.

points.en: Time series: observations in chronological order.
Models: Y = T + S + C + I or Y = T × S × C × I.
points.kn: ಮಾದರಿಗಳು: Y = T + S + C + I ಅಥವಾ Y = T × S × C × I.

homework.en: Give one example each of the four components from daily life.

narration.en: Recap. Time series: observations in chronological order. Components: trend, seasonal, cyclical, irregular. Models: Y = T + S + C + I or Y = T × S × C × I.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಕಾಲ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ: ಕಾಲಾನುಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಗಳು. ಘಟಕಗಳು: ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ, ಋತುಮಾನ, ಚಕ್ರೀಯ, ಅನಿಯಮಿತ. ಮಾದರಿಗಳು: Y = T + S + C + I ಅಥವಾ Y = T × S × C × I.
